areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Programme addresses public-space quality, green-area protection, flooding and climate-change mitigation.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities
areas.reason: Addresses precarious culture, tourism and market services in the historic centre, creating opportunities, jobs and income.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Indicators on formalized market vendors and formalized firms in the central area.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Same market and business-environment interventions expected to generate jobs and income.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Culture and tourism facilities, market requalification, public spaces, accessibility and urban mobility.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: Central-area population treated as a social minority benefiting from business, employment and service improvements.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: Refurbished building as a shelter and support house for LGBTQI+ people in vulnerability.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: New schools to reduce the educational deficit, a psychosocial care centre and therapeutic residences aligned with deinstitutionalization policy.
